description: API specification for USB Ports data interfaces and operations, including listing, retrieving, resetting statistics, and modifying port configurations.
published: Paths for listing, getting, resetting statistics, and setting USB port configurations

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Data.USB.Ports.List
methods.description: Retrieves a list of USB Ports with pagination support.

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Data.USB.Ports.{PortId}.Get
methods.description: Retrieves the status and configuration parameters for a specified USB Port.

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Data.USB.Ports.{PortId}.ResetStatistics
methods.description: Resets the statistics counters of the specified USB Port.

methods.name: Interfaces.Physical.Data.USB.Ports.{PortId}.Set
methods.description: Modifies the status and configuration parameters of the specified USB Port.
